description: Search open AI training / AI evaluation roles (RLHF, model rating, expert data work) across 20+ platforms by keyword and filters. Returns title, platform, pay, eligible countries and the aitrainer.work page for each role, most relevant first (newest first when there is no keyword). Every keyword must appear in the role, so use one to three words.

country.description: Only roles open to this country (English name, e.g. "India", "United States").

min_hourly_pay.description: Minimum hourly pay in USD (hourly roles only).

platform.description: Platform key, e.g. mercor, micro1, outlier, handshake, turing, mindrift. See list_platforms.

query.description: Words to match in the title or description, e.g. "physics", "Spanish", "lawyer".

name: search_jobs

pay.description: Pay as the listing states it. Text ending in "(estimate, not stated in the listing)" is our estimate; "(platform range, not this role's rate)" is the range the platform posts for all its projects.

url.description: The role page on aitrainer.work, with the full listing and the application link.

title: Search AI training jobs
